listing.name: Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition — Fatal-Fury-Wild-Ambition-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Experimental Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition source project. Upstream reports Windows startup and disc setup, with gameplay still being tested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own North American Fatal Fury: Wild Ambition disc, SLUS-01001. The framework’s BIOS requirement is not confirmed here; check upstream before preparing your files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build the game executable with CMake and PSXRECOMP_FORCE_SETUP_HOST=OFF. Follow upstream’s setup to generate game C code locally from your own disc. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: Upstream reports a Windows build, launcher, disc checks and game launch. Gameplay testing continues, and the setup-only path has an unknown-dispatch limitation. Portcove has not confirmed those runtime or gameplay results.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
